enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to left side. Stretch arms. Move hand under pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply.

Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wash body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Place bowl in sink. Rinse bowl. Wash bowl. Place bowl in dish rack. Wipe table. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for work and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Put laptop in backpack. Put notebook in backpack. Put pen in backpack. Zip backpack. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Put keys in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read news on phone. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter office building. Walk to office. Open office door. Walk to desk. Sit at desk.

Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Call community partner. Discuss program details. Write report. Print document. Review budget. Organize files. Make phone calls. Send emails. Update database. Attend team meeting. Take notes. Review documents.
Walk to cafeteria. Buy lunch. Carry tray to table. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk with colleague. Throw away trash. Walk back to office. Sit at desk. Check phone. Read news.

Continue working. Meet with team. Review budget. Make phone calls. Organize files. Write reports. Respond to emails. Attend webinar. Take notes. Update database. Print documents. File documents. Call partner. Discuss project. Plan event. Create schedule. Send invitations. Confirm attendance.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Arrive home.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Chop vegetables. Turn on InductionCooker. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off InductionCooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes. Place dishes in rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with fan, avoiding AC during peak hours
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Lie down. Close eyes. Breathe slowly.

Walk to living room. Turn on AirConditioner. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch show. Pick up snack. Eat snack. Drink water. Change channel. Watch another show. Turn off TV. Turn off AirConditioner. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Stretch arms. Move hand under pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping.
